## General



## Website Design


An overview of the various elements involved in designing and customizing the website's appearance.


### Main Design


This section covers the overall design elements of the website, including layout and structure.


### Header Design


Learn how to customize the header of the website, including logo placement and navigation setup.


### Logo Designer


Understand the options available for adding and customizing the website’s logo.


### Footer Colors


Explore how to adjust the colors and design of the website’s footer section.


## Additional Settings


Explore other customization options that enhance the functionality and aesthetics of the website.


### Main Menu Design


Details on how to style and configure the main navigation menu of the website.


### Button Colors


Instructions for changing the color scheme of buttons throughout the website.


### Member Profile Pages


Guide on customizing the design and layout of member profile pages.


### Search Results Pages


How to style and adjust the appearance of search results pages on the site.


### Content Boxes & Backgrounds


Instructions for modifying content boxes and background designs for a cohesive look.


### Sidebar Alignment


Tips on aligning and customizing sidebars to enhance the website’s layout.


### Website Announcement Message


Learn how to create and manage announcement messages that appear across your site.
